scope: Private qualification of accepted neural Improvise across the frozen 23 licensed sources and three style/energy strategies
temporary_uploads: Only the 23 hash-bound licensed source crops, reused in 69 requests; no new owner recordings or maker voice. Private R2 and Runpod. Remove temporary source and result objects after each stage; keep local evidence.
preconditions: Fresh explicit owner approval of this scope and cap
Exact existing immutable image, zero workers and queued/running jobs, zero pending production jobs
Local PostgreSQL reachable on 127.0.0.1:55438; independent test database per stage
At least 15 GiB free disk plus projected remaining study output
Stage claim is exclusive and single use; never erase a consumed claim
Before stages 2–7, previous receipt and independent GET/HEAD/SELECT postcheck must PASS
commands: From apps/site: JAMLOOM_TEST_DATABASE_URL points to the local PostgreSQL admin database; JAMLOOM_TRIAL_IMAGE equals image above. Never use production as test database.
Only after stage PASS: node --import tsx scripts/neural-study-postcheck.ts N
Advance N only after the independent postcheck succeeds; on any failure stop the entire campaign and preserve evidence.
failure_cleanup: If a stage fails, run its independent postcheck with --cleanup-only. A cleanup PASS with qualification FAIL never permits the next stage.
execution_order: Neural campaign first after AI DJ preflight-only stop; then AI DJ after independent cleanup. No concurrent GPU work.

cleanup_checker_correction.reason: Unsupported /endpoints/:id/workers GET returned 400. Use documented GET /endpoints/:id?includeWorkers=true; require explicit empty workers array plus all health worker counts zero. Read-only cleanup verification; no generation or scope changes.
cleanup_checker_correction.receipt_schema: Normalize the explicit REST worker array to the existing summary.total/workers receipt consumed by stage admission.
